ephesians.3.p1.b1.text: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles …

ephesians.3.p1.b2.text: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,

ephesians.3.p2.b1.text: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

ephesians.3.p2.b2.text: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.

ephesians.3.p2.b3.text: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, …

ephesians.3.p3.b1.text: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: …

ephesians.3.p3.b2.text: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.

ephesians.3.p3.b3.text: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.

ephesians.3.p4.b1.text: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,

ephesians.3.p4.b2.text: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,

ephesians.3.p5.b1.text: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,

ephesians.3.p5.b2.text: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, …

ephesians.3.p6.b1.text: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,

ephesians.3.p6.b2.text: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever.
